Welcome to Tower Stack, a delightful tower-builder game where precision, rhythm, and steady nerves are the keys to success. A crane swings building blocks high above the ground. Your mission is simple: drop each floor at the perfect moment to stack them cleanly on top of each other. How high can you climb before the tower topples?

• Time the Swing: Watch the crane as it swings a new house block left and right over your construction site.

• Tap to Drop: Hit the large "DROP" button at the bottom of the screen to release the block.
